# pqtransport

Pure-Dart post-quantum transport for Dart and Flutter.

- Package: https://github.com/turkananation/pqtransport
- Site: https://turkananation.github.io/pqtransport/
- Wiki: https://github.com/turkananation/pqtransport/wiki
- Docs: https://github.com/turkananation/pqtransport/blob/main/doc/INDEX.md
- Claim boundary: https://github.com/turkananation/pqtransport/blob/main/doc/CLAIM_BOUNDARY.md
- Crypto: package:pqforge ^0.4.13 (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, AES-256-GCM, AES-128-GCM, dart2js-safe ChaCha, X25519, P-256/P-384 ECDH and ECDSA, HKDF, X.509, HPKE, SHA-1 for NSEC3 and DS digest type 1)
- Infra: package:swissarmyknife (Result, StateMachine, CircuitBreaker, Cache)
- No dart:ffi. No platform TLS on the PQ path.
- Live handshake: all three RFC 10024 groups. P-384 requires PqForgeProfile.maximum. Profile/group mismatches fail closed (requireGroup). Fallback groups, when the peer offers only those: X25519, secp256r1, secp384r1, MLKEM1024.
- TLS encoding is RFC 8446-shaped. Cipher IANA 0x1302 (SHA-384 AES-GCM, default) and 0x1303 (ChaCha). Default certificate is RFC 7250 raw ML-DSA-65. Opt-in X.509 is a caller-supplied chain of 1 to 8. Not WebPKI. Not a browser.
- OpenSSL 3.5.9: the three hybrid groups, raw-pk and X.509, both directions, plus the four fallback groups. BoringSSL 0.20261020.0 is a TLS peer on X25519MLKEM768 and the four fallback groups, not SecP256r1MLKEM768 or SecP384r1MLKEM1024. curl is two HTTP/1.1 GETs. Not curl --http3.
- ECH (RFC 9849) is self-interop and one BoringSSL flight. DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) + AES-128-GCM via PqHpke (pqforge 0.4.14, HPKE since 0.4.10). Not an OpenSSL flight. Not GREASE. Not DNS.
- DNSSEC verifies algorithms 8, 13, 14, and 15 via pqforge. DS digests are SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-384. A caller-supplied root trust anchor drives an iterative resolver: referrals, glue, qname minimization, DNAME, CNAME, and secure, insecure, or bogus. NSEC and NSEC3 denial are cached and reused across names in the span. NSEC3 is hash algorithm 1, SHA-1 from pqforge. The iteration field allows 0 through 65535. The resolver's default ceiling is 0. The stub and the resolver set DO and CD, match the response id, retry truncation over TCP, and retry BADCOOKIE once. The AD bit is not validation. `DnsAuthoritativeZone` is a separate in-memory zone: AA, NODATA, NXDOMAIN, referral, REFUSED, FORMERR, and an unchased CNAME. It does not set AD and it does not sign. It is not the iterative resolver. Algorithms outside 5, 7, 8, 10, 13, 14, 15, and 16 are not verified.
- HTTP/2 is on PqTlsSocket (ALPN h2). HTTP/3 is on PqQuicConn (ALPN h3). Silent h2/h3 to h1 downgrade is refused. One in-memory masked RFC 6455 text frame can ride extended CONNECT on either. Not curl wss. Not Autobahn. Not a browser. RFC 7692 stays on HTTP/1.1. DNS_ASSIGN and PREF64 are encode/decode of provisional types only, not a masque-go flight. QUIC 0-RTT is in the Application Data packet number space, shared with 1-RTT. The ClientHello sends psk_key_exchange_modes with psk_dhe_ke. Early data is replayable. A replayed ticket accepts none. One in-memory HTTP/3 request uses the QPACK static table on the early bidi stream. A 0-RTT DATAGRAM is not resent. More than one PSK identity is offered; early data is index 0 only. A ticketKey store resumes without 0-RTT. Not RFC 9258. Not a fourth space. quiche 0.30.0 sent pq-0rtt on stream 4 once. That flight is not an HTTP/3 request. A path id above 0 has its own PTO in memory. ECN-CE is a NewReno event, not CUBIC. Not curl --http3. psk_ke is not selected. ECH together with 0-RTT is refused.
- Optional mDNS TXT field pqslh= is SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f. The default announce path stays ML-DSA-65 (pqsig=). mDNS stays that one set. TLS CertificateVerify may opt in to IANA 0x0911-0x091C. The handshake test is SHA2-128f only. Not the default signature. Not a foreign peer. Optional TlsClientAuth is a raw public-key allow-list, not an X.509 client chain, and not sent on PSK resume. compress_certificate is zlib only when offered. Not brotli. Not zstd. The web build has no zlib.
- Not a FIPS 140 module.

Start at doc/INDEX.md. Do not invent FIPS/CMVP, constant-time, or erasure claims.
